description: Your account's sending limits and current usage: the daily cap (a rolling 24 hours, 250/day for new accounts until a volume request is approved), how many live messages were sent in the last 24 hours and how many remain, the probation status that gates "request a higher volume" (it opens 30 days after the first live send), the per-recipient cap (recipient_rate_per_hour / recipient_rate_per_day: a breach comes back as RECIPIENT_RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After), whether live sending is currently paused and until when, and past volume requests. Check this when a send is refused with DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED, RECIPIENT_RATE_LIMITED or SENDING_PAUSED, or before a batch of sends.
name: get_send_limit
title: Get sending limits
